verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for an AI agent that acts on banking, payroll and Stripe, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment. The closest item is that writes pause for human sign-off (afk-docs-7), which is an approval gate on production actions, not isolation from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
